notice: Derived automatically from REHAB24-6 CALIBRATION subjects, front view only (see derived_from/subjects below) -- NOT the live shipped config. A licensed physiotherapist must still review before use. n=9 deviation reps -- BELOW the 30-rep caution threshold.

tol_peak_deg.comment: p95 of max(0, ref_median - measured), pooled over calibration subjects' remaining correct reps

target_peak_deg.comment: (p5+p95)/2 of peak_angle across calibration-subject correct front-view reps

cue_cooldown_s.comment: not data-derived -- same operational default as config/exercises/shoulder_abduction.json

min_valid_fraction.comment: not data-derived -- same operational default as config/exercises/shoulder_abduction.json

cues.peak_angle: Raise your arm closer to the target height.
cues.elbow_straight: Keep your elbow straighter as you raise your arm.
cues.trunk_lean: Keep your torso upright -- try not to lean.
cues.tempo: Move at a steadier, more controlled pace.
cues.insufficient_data: Keep your whole arm in view.
